summary: Two backcountry skiers were caught in an approximately 6-foot-deep, 1,200-foot-wide avalanche in Paradise Bowl on the west side of Cameron Pass on Saturday morning; one skier (Joe Philpott) was killed and his companion Alex White, 24, was buried for more than three hours before being dug out alive by State Forest State Park rangers, surviving with a torn ACL and MCL and a lacerated calf.
location: Paradise Bowl, west side of Cameron Pass, State Forest State Park
responding_agency: State Forest State Park rangers (Colorado Parks and Wildlife)
notes: SnowBrains retelling of the Denver Post account (opened this run); 2013-03-02 weekday-verified Saturday; zero 2013-03-02 rows, zero Paradise Bowl/Alex White tokens. A 2016 retrospective of the same incident names the responding rescuers as State Forest State Park Rangers Sam McCloskey and Andrew Maddox. UN 2016 retrospective (opened run 448) notes the victim's dog also died in the slide.
